sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def cursor(frame):
    ls=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ws=[]
    for r in range(38,63):
        for c in range(10,55):
            if ls[r][c]=='W': ws.append((r,c))
    return ws
def sig(frame, r0, c0):
    ls = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('1' if ls[r][c]=='B' else '0' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
print("cursor now:", cursor(current_frame))
p0=sig(current_frame,52,22); b0=sig(current_frame,41,22)
for i in range(5):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print("after LEFT",i+1,"cursor:",cursor(current_frame),"pink1:",sig(current_frame,52,22)==p0,"blue1:",sig(current_frame,41,22)==b0)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
